example: B2B cut. The hero is the viewer, 'Your brand'. The buyer asks: 'Who's the best IT partner for a cloud migration?'. The un-blurred, 'Illustrative' answer names the real Infosys, TCS and Accenture; 'Your brand' is missing, then named in s13. Real brands appear only as what AI recommends today, never as a hyperank client. App screens track yourbrand.com with rivals Infosys, TCS and Accenture.
device: INTERACTIVE QUESTIONS: each act opens with a question to the viewer typed into the same glass chat composer (blinking cursor, letter by letter), then the voice answers it. The composer is the film's recurring object, along with the AI answer card it produces.

scenes.vo: Right now, a buyer is asking AI about the category you sell in. It could be anything.
scenes.tts: Right now, a buyer is asking A-I about the category you sell in. It could be anything.
scenes.visual: Bright stage with depth. Frame 1 already moving: the glass chat composer with the official ChatGPT mark types a question, deletes it, types another, quick and confident: 'Best CRM for a small sales team?', 'Best cybersecurity firm for a bank?', 'Who's the best IT partner for a cloud migration?'. On 'It could be anything' the questions fan out into a soft stack of many category questions on focal planes. Official engine marks (Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Overviews, Meta AI) float behind. Never Grok. SFX: key ticks.

scenes.vo: AI answers with a shortlist. Is it you? Or your competitor?
scenes.tts: A-I answers with a shortlist. Is it you? Or your competitor?
scenes.visual: THE HERO ANSWER CARD streams in below the composer: a ranked shortlist of three rows whose product names are BLURRED out, each with a citation chip. On 'Is it you?' the first blurred name pulses violet; on 'Or your competitor?' the other two pulse. The names never resolve here. Small corner tag 'Illustrative'.

scenes.vo: Right now, you don't know. Nothing in your analytics will tell you.
scenes.tts: Right now, you don't know. Nothing in your analytics will tell you.
scenes.visual: The blurred answer card holds at centre. A large soft question mark forms behind it. Two glass analytics tiles drift in at the sides, 'AI answers about you: unknown', 'Mentioned by ChatGPT: unknown'. The cursor in the composer blinks.

scenes.vo: In a G2 survey, half of B2B software buyers now start their research with an AI chatbot more often than with Google.
scenes.tts: In a G-2 survey, half of B-2-B software buyers now start their research with an A-I chatbot more often than with Google.
scenes.visual: The answer card drifts back out of focus. '51%' rises large in violet with a soft depth shadow, count already in motion on frame 1, then holds. Source line bottom-left, small: 'Source: G2, The Answer Economy, April 2026. Survey of 1,076 B2B software buyers.'

scenes.vo: And 69 percent chose a different vendor than planned, because a chatbot recommended it.
scenes.tts: And sixty-nine percent chose a different vendor than planned, because a chatbot recommended it.
scenes.visual: The 51 rolls to 69 in place. Below it, a 'Planned vendor' chip slides out of a buyer's shortlist and a 'Recommended by AI' chip slides in. Same source line.

scenes.vo: When it's not you, you never see the loss. No visit, no form fill, nothing in your CRM.
scenes.tts: When it's not you, you never see the loss. No visit, no form fill, nothing in your C-R-M.
scenes.visual: Three glass tiles in depth, each flat-lining in turn: 'Website visits, no change', 'Form fills, no change', 'CRM, no record'.

scenes.vo: That's where hyperank comes in. We show you what AI says, and we get your brand mentioned and cited, so buyers find you first.
scenes.tts: That's where Hyper rank comes in. We show you what A-I says, and we get your brand mentioned and cited, so buyers find you first.
scenes.visual: SIGNATURE MOMENT, bright throughout. The stage clears to white, the hyperank mark draws itself with a soft violet glow, a light sweep crosses the frame, and the full silver laptop rises and settles with a slight rotateX and a specular sweep across the lid. Its screen shows the hyperank.ai hero (site crop hero.png, the visor figure). The 'ChatGPT recommends you', 'Claude recommends you' chips lift off the screen one at a time.

scenes.vo: First, you see the answer. hyperank asks your buyers' real questions across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and more, and keeps every answer. Here, AI names Infosys, TCS and Accenture. Not you.
scenes.tts: First, you see the answer. Hyper rank asks your buyers' real questions across Chat G-P-T, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and more, and keeps every answer. Here, A-I names Infosys, TCS and Accenture. Not you.
scenes.visual: Viewer question typed in the composer: 'What does AI say about my brand?'. PAYOFF OF THE BLUR: the hero answer card from s02 returns and UN-BLURS: '1. Infosys', '2. TCS', '3. Accenture' (Illustrative), with an empty, greyed 'Your brand' row. Then the laptop screen wipes to the site section 'Every answer, kept word for word' (card-answers.png, 2x); camera pushes in; ONE lift: the Tracked prompts card with this category's questions.

scenes.vo: You see who gets named instead of you, your share of voice, and anything AI gets wrong, like an outdated service list.
scenes.tts: You see who gets named instead of you, your share of voice, and anything A-I gets wrong, like an outdated service list.
scenes.visual: Screen wipes to the app Control Center for yourbrand.com. Lift 1, large: Share of voice, Your brand 9% beside Infosys, TCS and Accenture. Lift 2: one AI claim 'Your brand only works with startups' struck through in place, verdict pill 'Outdated'. Never more than two lifts.

scenes.vo: Why does AI pick them, and not you? The sources it trusts. Reviews, Reddit threads, comparison pages. hyperank finds the exact sources deciding your answer.
scenes.tts: Why does A-I pick them, and not you? The sources it trusts. Reviews, Reddit threads, comparison pages. Hyper rank finds the exact sources deciding your answer.
scenes.visual: Viewer question typed first: 'Why does AI pick them?'. MATCH CUT: the hero answer card from s02 returns above the laptop; its citation chips drop and unfold into the site's 'Sources deciding the answer' graph (sources-deciding.png, 2x, rival labels as Infosys, TCS, Accenture). The '+ Add' buttons light in sequence.

scenes.vo: Then we fix them. We create what those sources are missing: roundups, comparisons, persona pages, listicles, how-tos and articles, each engineered the way AI picks what to cite.
scenes.tts: Then we fix them. We create what those sources are missing: roundups, comparisons, persona pages, listicles, how-tos and articles, each engineered the way A-I picks what to cite.
scenes.visual: Six page cards fan out from the laptop screen in a shallow 3D arc, one per format word, each with a real title for this category ('Best cloud migration partners for mid-size banks, compared', 'A specialist or a global SI: who to hire for Azure', 'Cloud migration for 500-person insurers' ...). On 'engineered' the arc collapses into ONE large page with three passages highlighting in violet ink: 'Direct answer', 'Clear facts', 'Sourced stat'. Use the site's Content Engine graphic (card-content.png) for the publish list.

scenes.vo: It publishes to your site and the sites AI reads. And our agents join the Reddit and LinkedIn threads where your buyers are already asking.
scenes.tts: It publishes to your site and the sites A-I reads. And our agents join the Reddit and LinkedIn threads where your buyers are already asking.
scenes.visual: The page flies into the site's integrations cards (integrations4.png: WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify), each lighting as it lands. Then a Reddit thread card ('r/sysadmin: who to hire for an Azure migration?') with a drafted reply naming Your brand and citing a source, beside a LinkedIn post card. Official Reddit and LinkedIn marks.

scenes.vo: Weeks later, a buyer asks the same question. This time, AI names you, and links to you.
scenes.tts: Weeks later, a buyer asks the same question. This time, A-I names you, and links to you.
scenes.visual: PAYOFF of the hero card. The same composer types the same s01 question. The answer re-streams; this time 'Your brand' is in the list with a violet citation chip 'yourbrand.com'. Corner tag 'Illustrative'. Soft chime.

scenes.vo: They click. They land on your site. They book a call. That's a new client, sent by AI.
scenes.tts: They click. They land on your site. They book a call. That's a new client, sent by A-I.
scenes.visual: A cursor clicks the yourbrand.com citation; the laptop screen wipes to a clean 'Your brand' landing page (no pricing); a 'Discovery call booked' toast slides in, then 'New client: regional bank'.

scenes.vo: And hyperank proves it. AI visits, separated from direct traffic, engine by engine, in a report for your board.
scenes.tts: And Hyper rank proves it. A-I visits, separated from direct traffic, engine by engine, in a report for your board.
scenes.visual: The site's 'The traffic AI sends you, separated from the traffic it does not' graphic (card-analytics.png, 2x): referral bars for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude grow in. Then a board report cover lands on the laptop.

scenes.vo: No team for this? We run it for you. We audit your domain, then every week we fix sources and publish under your name. Not a retainer. An extra team member. Running an agency? Run every client from one place, under your brand.
scenes.tts: No team for this? We run it for you. We audit your domain, then every week we fix sources and publish under your name. Not a retainer. An extra team member. Running an agency? Run every client from one place, under your brand.
scenes.visual: Viewer question typed first: 'No team for this?'. A four-week strip with real items: Week 1 'Audit and baseline', Week 2 'Sources fixed', Week 3 'Pages published', Week 4 'Report sent'. On 'An extra team member' the Workspace members card shows a 'hyperank team' seat sliding in, highlighted violet. On 'agency', three client workspace cards fan out behind it.

scenes.vo: Want to know what AI tells your buyers about you right now? Book a call. Bring your domain. In thirty minutes, see your answer, and who it names instead.
scenes.tts: Want to know what A-I tells your buyers about you right now? Book a call. Bring your domain. In thirty minutes, see your answer, and who it names instead.
scenes.visual: Viewer question typed in the composer: 'What does AI say about my brand right now?'. Beside it a clean calendar card 'Talk to us, 30 min' with a 'Book a call' button and hyperank.ai/book.

scenes.vo: Your buyers are already asking. Be the answer. Book a call, or check your brand free, at hyperank.ai.
scenes.tts: Your buyers are already asking. Be the answer. Book a call, or check your brand free, at Hyper rank dot A-I.
scenes.visual: End card bookending the reveal: the hyperank mark with a soft violet glow, 'Book a call' primary button with hyperank.ai/book, 'Check your brand free' secondary with hyperank.ai. Holds 2.5 s.
